archive_scope: Six existing simulation checkpoints and their version/course descriptions; no hardware promotion or training-source companion.
course_encoding: Start from base_environment_config/base_stage_config. Apply each stage environment_patch/stage_patch in order, removing the explicitly listed keys. Index1 patches are empty. Every stage field, reward, reset, observation and gate value is retained. A singleton object with key __float__ encodes IEEE Infinity, -Infinity or NaN; decode these before reconstructing or hashing configurations. Values use SI units unless the original field explicitly names another unit.
course_semantics: Declared final-profile definitions are separated from inherited historical graduations. In particular, earlier V319 passes are not re-certified under later redefined gates/rewards.
observation_boundary: V274 S9 has external-force DR but ball-position AR1 disabled. S10 introduces AR1; S11 consolidates it.
source_scope: Referenced source snapshots, commands, full CSVs, inherited checkpoints and historical evidence are provenance references and are not all included in this eight-file model archive.
